translations.title: Almagate 500 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine neutralises stomach acid and eases symptoms of stomach and duodenal ulcers, gastritis, excess stomach acid, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and acid burping.
translations.usage: Adults and children 12 or older chew two tablets (1 g) three times a day, 30 minutes to 1 hour after meals. If needed, one more dose may be taken before bed.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you have Alzheimer's disease, haemorrhoids, fluid retention (swelling), pregnancy-induced toxaemia or diarrhoea, or if you have bleeding in the digestive tract that has not been diagnosed. Talk to a pharmacist if you have kidney problems, are elderly, have trouble absorbing food, or have signs of bleeding such as black stools, or are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not take it together with tetracycline antibiotics. If your symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks, stop taking it and talk to a pharmacist or doctor.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Heartburn, excess stomach acid, acid burping, stomach pain, nausea
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Kidney problems; take care with long-term use
